statuses.label: Still Operational
statuses.definition: The machine is still working and sending information back to Earth.

statuses.label: Mission Completed
statuses.definition: The machine finished the job it was sent to do.

statuses.label: Lost Contact
statuses.definition: The machine stopped responding, so we can no longer hear from it.

statuses.label: Stopped Working
statuses.definition: The machine broke or ran out of power and can no longer do its job.

statuses.label: Crashed on Landing
statuses.definition: The machine hit the ground too hard while trying to land and was damaged.

statuses.label: Intentionally Left Behind
statuses.definition: The machine was left in place on purpose after it finished its job.

statuses.label: Destroyed or Burned Up
statuses.definition: The machine was destroyed, often by burning up in intense heat.

statuses.label: Deliberate Impact
statuses.definition: The machine was guided to crash into a surface on purpose, often to study the impact.
